record.title: ADR-SAG-0018: the decision was sound, the record left two things out
record.evidence: before and after: three runs each, reported by ai-lead 2026-11-25 · later single runs scored context 0.80 · the answer for alternatives after the edit was not captured · model jev-1.14.0

result.before: Verdict no on 3 of 3 runs · lowest 0.43
result.after: Verdict yes on 3 of 3 runs · lowest 0.83
result.summary: Two additions. The decision itself did not change.

edits.check_label: Does the context name the problem?
edits.fault: Jev answered "background only": the context gave background but named no problem. That answer alone gives verdict no.

added.text: The problem is keeping the rendered release files consistent with that input and the pinned kit.

edits.check_label: Are the alternatives named, with why each lost?
edits.fault: Jev answered "none": the record named no alternative. That answer alone gives verdict no.

added.text: Alternative 1: Ad-hoc workflow edits. Description: Edit release workflows directly rather than use sc-publish. Why Rejected: The pinned kit owns the rendered release files; direct edits can drift from its consumer input.
